title: 銅柱微凸塊製作
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入凸塊共面性、電流密度與界面可靠度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore bump coplanarity, current density and interface reliability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 互連幾何與來料
stages.description: 針對互連幾何與來料完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interconnect geometry and input, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 焊墊與凸塊座標｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Pad and bump coordinates | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對焊墊與凸塊座標，把「焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For pad and bump coordinates, turn "Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「焊墊與凸塊座標」的模型：焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for pad and bump coordinates: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付焊墊與凸塊座標的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for pad and bump coordinates, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 焊墊與凸塊座標：機制
knowledge.text: 焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。
knowledge.textEn: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 必須排除的錯判：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Misinterpretation to reject: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「銅柱微凸塊製作」的「焊墊與凸塊座標｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Pad and bump coordinates | mechanism and design” in “Copper-pillar microbump fabrication”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「焊墊與凸塊座標」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For pad and bump coordinates — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。
以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊
初始電阻低就代表疲勞壽命長
optionsEn: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area.
Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap
Assuming low initial resistance proves long fatigue life
quiz.explanation: 焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 因此不能採用「以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊」。
quiz.explanationEn: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Therefore reject: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap.

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Challenge the hypothesis "Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付焊墊與凸塊座標的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for pad and bump coordinates: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 種子層連續性｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Seed continuity | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對種子層連續性，把「開路種子層使局部電位與沉積量失控；名義厚度相同不保證跨地形導通。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For seed continuity, turn "A discontinuous seed disrupts local potential and deposition; identical nominal thickness does not guarantee continuity over topography." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「種子層連續性」的模型：開路種子層使局部電位與沉積量失控；名義厚度相同不保證跨地形導通。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「以片電阻地圖配合截面查看孔邊覆蓋，將探針接觸異常另列。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for seed continuity: A discontinuous seed disrupts local potential and deposition; identical nominal thickness does not guarantee continuity over topography. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Combine sheet-resistance maps with cross-sections at aperture edges and isolate probe-contact errors. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 以片電阻地圖配合截面查看孔邊覆蓋，將探針接觸異常另列。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Combine sheet-resistance maps with cross-sections at aperture edges and isolate probe-contact errors. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：僅用中心種子厚度證明全片電鍍連通。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using center seed thickness alone to prove plating continuity. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付種子層連續性的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for seed continuity, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

Misinterpretation to reject: Using center seed thickness alone to prove plating continuity. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「種子層連續性」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For seed continuity — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 僅用中心種子厚度證明全片電鍍連通
總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查
開路種子層使局部電位與沉積量失控；名義厚度相同不保證跨地形導通。

Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks
A discontinuous seed disrupts local potential and deposition; identical nominal thickness does not guarantee continuity over topography.

steps.title: 光阻孔洞與側壁｜機制與設計

steps.objective: 針對光阻孔洞與側壁，把「孔徑、側壁角與光阻厚度共同決定柱的截面與可成長高度；顯影殘留可阻斷底部成核。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For resist apertures and sidewalls, turn "Aperture size, sidewall angle and resist thickness jointly constrain pillar shape and height; developer residue can obstruct nucleation." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「光阻孔洞與側壁」的模型：孔徑、側壁角與光阻厚度共同決定柱的截面與可成長高度；顯影殘留可阻斷底部成核。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較俯視孔徑、底部開口與截面角度，不把頂口尺寸當作柱底尺寸。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for resist apertures and sidewalls: Aperture size, sidewall angle and resist thickness jointly constrain pillar shape and height; developer residue can obstruct nucleation. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare top-view diameter, bottom opening and cross-section angle; the top opening is not the base diameter. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較俯視孔徑、底部開口與截面角度，不把頂口尺寸當作柱底尺寸。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare top-view diameter, bottom opening and cross-section angle; the top opening is not the base diameter. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：頂口尺寸合格即代表柱底無殘留。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming a correct top opening proves a residue-free base. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付光阻孔洞與側壁的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for resist apertures and sidewalls, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 光阻孔洞與側壁：機制
knowledge.text: 孔徑、側壁角與光阻厚度共同決定柱的截面與可成長高度；顯影殘留可阻斷底部成核。
knowledge.textEn: Aperture size, sidewall angle and resist thickness jointly constrain pillar shape and height; developer residue can obstruct nucleation.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較俯視孔徑、底部開口與截面角度，不把頂口尺寸當作柱底尺寸。 必須排除的錯判：頂口尺寸合格即代表柱底無殘留。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare top-view diameter, bottom opening and cross-section angle; the top opening is not the base diameter. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming a correct top opening proves a residue-free base. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.explanationEn: Aperture size, sidewall angle and resist thickness jointly constrain pillar shape and height; developer residue can obstruct nucleation. Compare top-view diameter, bottom opening and cross-section angle; the top opening is not the base diameter. Therefore reject: Assuming a correct top opening proves a residue-free base.

steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare top-view diameter, bottom opening and cross-section angle; the top opening is not the base diameter. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming a correct top opening proves a residue-free base" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.

steps.failure: 避免：頂口尺寸合格即代表柱底無殘留。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming a correct top opening proves a residue-free base. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付光阻孔洞與側壁的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for resist apertures and sidewalls: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
